details:
I would really love a feature to turn off friend requests. This has been a HUGE issue for me, As I have had multiple stalkers making multiple accounts. So you block one very toxic person, Then when you finally cheer yourself up you receive a friend request, You will think "oh maybe someone I met recently" or " a friend of a friend " and then you accept the request out of curiosity only to find out it's that toxic person you decided to block.

I think it's very important for the mental health as a whole for the community to have a way to turn off friend requests..

Once something is buried and left to the past it should be show, There's no need to dig up old wounds or past stress, And VRChat having an ability to turn off this feature entirely would really help.

So if there's someone who mistreated you a long time and they decide to make 10 accounts and they wish you ill, You don't have to worry, You can recover and be happy and be on your way.

Being able to be open after abuse is a wonderful thing..

It's a shame VRChat doesn't have any tools to protect victims of abuse and stalking.
title: Turn Off Friend Requests (Like Discord)
